workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad! I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the times when both of them are free next week (Mon Nov 16 - Fri Nov 20, 9:00-17:00 Eastern):

- Monday: 09:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

Please check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which of these slots work for them too. We need a 30-minute slot where all four can attend.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison! I've checked Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars. Unfortunately, none of the slots you listed work for both of them. However, here are the times when BOTH Elena and David are free next week:

- Monday: 11:00-12:00
- Tuesday: 09:00-10:00
- Wednesday: 13:00-14:00
- Thursday: 09:30-10:00, 14:30-15:30
- Friday: 15:00-16:00

Could you check which of these slots work for Priya Raman and Marcus Hale? We need a 30-minute slot where all four can meet.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I've carefully cross-referenced our availability lists. Unfortunately, there is no overlap between when Priya & Marcus are both free and when Elena & David are both free:

- Monday: P/M free 09:00-10:00, E/D free 11:00-12:00 → No overlap
- Tuesday: P/M free 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00, E/D free 09:00-10:00 → No overlap
- Wednesday: P/M free 15:00-16:00, E/D free 13:00-14:00 → No overlap
- Thursday: P/M free 10:00-10:30, E/D free 09:30-10:00, 14:30-15:30 → No overlap
- Friday: P/M free 11:00-12:00, E/D free 15:00-16:00 → No overlap

There appears to be no 30-minute slot when all four partners are available next week. I recommend we report this as infeasible. Please confirm you agree, or let me know if you find an overlap I missed.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison, I've carefully re-verified my analysis of Elena and David's calendars, and I confirm there is no overlap with Priya and Marcus's availability. Your cross-reference is correct. I agree we should report this as infeasible.

For the record, my E/D free times are:
- Monday: 11:00-12:00
- Tuesday: 09:00-10:00
- Wednesday: 13:00-14:00
- Thursday: 09:30-10:00, 14:30-15:30
- Friday: 15:00-16:00

None of these overlap with P/M free times. I'll call report_infeasible now.

infeasible.reason: After cross-referencing all four partners' calendars, there is no 30-minute slot next week (Mon Nov 16 - Fri Nov 20, 9:00-17:00 Eastern) when all four partners are available. Priya and Marcus's mutual free times do not overlap with Elena and David's mutual free times on any day.
